ticker: DROP 04 · BLACK CHROME · ENTRIES OPEN · ONE ENTRY PER VERIFIED IDENTITY · WINNERS DRAWN LIVE

hero.lede: "The friends-and-family pair that never had a fair chance. Until now."

story.headline: Ten pairs. One city. Never on shelves.
story.p1: In 2015, Carhartt and Eminem stitched a friends-and-family run of Air Jordan 4s for Shady Records' inner circle in Detroit. Roughly ten pairs were made. None were sold. Most never left the city.
story.p2: The shoe was named for what you couldn't quite see — chrome flecks woven through black workwear canvas, the kind of detail that only reveals itself under the right light. It became one of the most quietly mythic Jordan 4s ever produced.
story.pullquote: "Some shoes you collect. This one you wait for."
story.p3: Drop 04 is not a retro. It's the lottery the original release never had. 1,200 pairs, drawn live, one shot per verified identity. The friends-and-family experience, finally for everyone.

enter.headline: One name. One pair. One draw.
enter.body: Submit your details below. We verify by email and SMS, then enter you into the live draw. The algorithm is published. The random seed is recorded. No back doors.
enter.consent: I confirm I am over 16 and that this is my only entry.
enter.footnote: By entering you agree to fair-draw terms and email/SMS verification.
enter.selectedFootnote: Check your email for next steps. Card not charged until pickup.

faq.headline: Questions, answered.
faq.lede: If your question isn't here, we're a quick email away.
faq.a1: Submit your details, verify by email and SMS, and you're entered. On the draw date, 1,200 names are selected from the entry pool. If you're picked, we email you within minutes. Card is charged only after selection.
faq.q2: How do I know the draw is fair?
faq.a2: We use Node's crypto.randomInt — the same primitive used in cryptographic key generation. The random seed is logged at draw time. The full entry list and seed are publicly verifiable. No hidden weighting. No back doors.
faq.a3: Only after you're selected. We collect card details at entry for verification, but no charge happens unless your name is drawn. You'll have 24 hours after selection to confirm before we charge the ₪1,200.
faq.a4: Limited-drop sneakers are non-returnable. We sell exactly what's photographed — original packaging, all extras, never worn. If your pair arrives defective or in the wrong size, we'll replace or refund within 14 days of delivery.
faq.q5: How do I pick the right size?
faq.a5: Air Jordan 4s run true to size for most. If you're between sizes, go down half a size — the canvas upper stretches with wear. Sizing chart with cm/EU equivalents lives in the entry form.
faq.a6: Because resale bots flood every drop. By verifying email and SMS, we ensure each entry represents one real person. The same identity can't enter twice. That's how we get pairs into the hands of people who actually want to wear them.

footer.closing: Made with care in Tel Aviv · 2026 · SOLE
